newsitem.title: USA: Lunar Corp reaches litigation settlement.
newsitem.headline: Lunar Corp reaches litigation settlement.

text.p: Lunar Corp said Monday it reached a settlement in its litigation against a unit of EG&G Inc for alleged patent infringement.

Lunar, along with the University of Alabama's Birmingham Research Center Foundation, originally sued EG&G Astrophysics over the design of one of its products, a dual-scanning baggage security scanner, a Lunar spokesman said.
EG&G Astrophysics agreed to pay a $4.2 million judgment and sign a non-exclusive royalty-bearing license for the remaining term of the patents, Lunar said.
Lunar develops products for the diagnosis of osteoporosis and other diseases. The product line uses dual-energy scanning under a license from the University of Alabama.
Its stock closed down 1/4 at 34 Monday.
